title: ASNER: Software Architecture Recovery with Adaptive Semantic Neighborhoods and Evidence-Grounded Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2610.36894v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated software architecture recovery provides architectural context for software engineering and repository-level LLM agents. Existing methods combine structural and semantic signals, but functional relatedness does not necessarily imply shared architectural responsibility. Fixed thresholds or Top-K neighborhoods also ignore repository scale and local similarity distributions, introducing errors that propagate through clustering. Unconstrained LLM refinement may further alter correct assignments without sufficient evidence. We propose ASNER (Adaptive Semantic Neighborhoods and Evidence-Grounded Refinement for Software Architecture Recovery), based on responsibility-aware, project-adaptive relation modeling and evidence-grounded boundary verification. ASNER derives structured file responsibilities with an LLM, constructs semantic neighborhoods that adapt to repository scale and local similarity distributions, and augments a static dep

translated_title: ASNER：基于自适应语义邻域与证据支撑细化的软件架构恢复
translated_abstract: 自动化软件架构恢复为软件工程和仓库级LLM智能体提供架构上下文。现有方法结合了结构和语义信号，但功能上的相关性并不一定意味着共享架构职责。固定阈值或Top-K邻域的方法也忽略了仓库规模和局部相似度分布，从而引入会在聚类过程中传播的错误。而不受约束的LLM细化可能会在没有充分证据的情况下改变原本正确的分配。我们提出了ASNER（基于自适应语义邻域与证据支撑细化的软件架构恢复方法），其基础是职责感知的、项目自适应的关系建模以及证据支撑的边界验证。ASNER利用LLM推导出结构化的文件职责，构建能够适应仓库规模和局部相似度分布的语义邻域，并对静态依赖……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ASNER通过职责感知、项目自适应的关系建模构建自适应语义邻域，并采用证据约束的LLM边界验证机制，解决了固定阈值忽略仓库规模、功能相关性误导架构职责判断以及无约束LLM细化破坏正确结果的问题，从而提升软件架构恢复的准确性。
en_tdlr: ASNER improves software architecture recovery through responsibility-aware, project-adaptive relation modeling with adaptive semantic neighborhoods and evidence-grounded LLM refinement that verifies boundaries before altering assignments.
